question: What does the official NFRDI Sorsogon Bay fisheries assessment support, and what remains necessary before any data can be used as species or catch records in Bangwit?

sourcesReviewed.title: Assessment of the Fisheries of Sorsogon Bay (Region 5)
sourcesReviewed.provider: BFAR National Fisheries Research and Development Institute, Technical Paper Series
sourcesReviewed.citation: Olaño, V. L., Vergara, M. B., & Gonzales, F. L. (2009, December). Assessment of the Fisheries of Sorsogon Bay (Region 5). BFAR-NFRDI Technical Paper Series, 12(4).
sourcesReviewed.access: Official NFRDI PDF downloaded; abstract, study scope, methods, selected results and conclusions reviewed. No item-specific license or reuse terms were verified.

methodsAsReported: Historical fish landing monitoring and catch-by-gear records
Fishing boat and gear inventory across five municipalities surrounding the bay
Catch, effort, catch-per-unit-effort, seasonality and length-frequency analyses
studyScopeAsReported.taxonomicCoverageAsReported: The report describes 25 dominant fish species and 10 dominant invertebrate species selected by consistency and volume of catch. This is a selected dominant subset, not an exhaustive checklist.
studyScopeAsReported.geographicScopeCaveat: The report names the five coastal municipalities Casiguran, Castilla, Magallanes, Juban and Sorsogon. Its methods refer to 67 bordering barangays, while results refer to 64; the discrepancy is unresolved. Landing centers are not per-catch capture coordinates.

canSupport: A dated historical fisheries-assessment source for Sorsogon Bay covering April 1999 to March 2003.
A lead for the paper's selected dominant finfish and invertebrate taxa and historical gear-level catch composition, subject to manual taxon transcription and rights review.
cannotSupport: A complete fish or aquatic-species checklist for Sorsogon Bay, Bicol or the Philippines.
A current occurrence, abundance, capture coordinate or population claim for a named landing-center municipality.
A freshwater river/lake record, diet or bait recommendation, native/introduced status, legal catchability, fishing rule or safety statement.

missingEvidence: No event-level raw landing rows or fish-to-capture-location crosswalk were imported or verified in this review.
No specimen vouchers, accession identifiers or taxon-by-event coordinates were established.
No item-specific rights/license statement or authorization to reproduce its tables or derived records was verified.
The source references a separate 1995 Sorsogon Bay checklist of fishes caught; that checklist and its reuse terms were not retrieved in this step.

disposition.reason: The paper provides useful historical aggregate fishery evidence, but it is not an exhaustive checklist, its landing locations do not locate catches, and reuse rights are unresolved.

nextAction: Locate the cited 1995 Sorsogon Bay fish checklist or underlying NSAP records, verify current custody and reuse terms, and continue separate river, lake, reservoir, estuary, mangrove, seagrass and reef source review across Bicol.

sources.supports: Official NFRDI Technical Paper Series PDF; bibliographic details and historical survey methods, period, landing centers and aggregate fishery results.
Official Philippine Journal of Fisheries/NFRDI technical bulletin archive entry for the report.
